ticket.subject: URGENT: all our invoices are failing to send
ticket.body: This is unacceptable. Since this morning EVERY invoice we try to send fails and our clients are waiting for payment details. We have 40 invoices stuck and I have already tried three times. We pay for this service and it is costing us money right now. Fix this immediately or we will look for another provider.

note: Angry and urgent, not covered by the KB: escalate on high urgency with negative sentiment and no grounded answer.
